definitions.explanation: Half of a circle, or a shape resembling one. Used both as a geometric term and in everyday description of curved shapes and arrangements.

examples.japanese: {紙|かみ}を{半円|はんえん}に{切|き}った。
examples.english: I cut the paper into a semicircle.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたちが{半円|はんえん}の{形|かたち}に{並|なら}んだ。
examples.english: The children lined up in a half circle.

examples.japanese: {虹|にじ}はきれいな{半円|はんえん}を{描|えが}いて{空|そら}にかかっていた。
examples.english: The rainbow hung in the sky, tracing a beautiful semicircle.

notes:
{半|はん} (half) + {円|えん} (circle). The same {半|はん} gives {半分|はんぶん} (half) and {半年|はんとし} (half a year).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {半円|はんえん}{形|けい}: semicircular in shape
- {半円|はんえん}を{描|えが}く: to trace a semicircle
- {半円|はんえん}{状|じょう}に{並|なら}ぶ: to be arranged in a half circle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {円|えん}: circle — the full shape
- {半径|はんけい}: radius — a measurement, not a shape; {半|はん} here means half the diameter
